name: Scene to Shot List
description: Declarative shot planning from a scene goal. Does not generate images, video, or camera files.

stages.title: Scene Goal
stages.intent: Restate the scene goal in visual terms.

stages.title: Visual Beat
stages.intent: Name the picture-change that carries the turn.

stages.title: Shot
stages.intent: Declare a shot identity. No image is generated.

stages.title: Framing
stages.intent: Wide, medium, close, insert, or other intended scale.

stages.title: Camera Angle
stages.intent: Eye-level, high, low, subjective, or overhead as intent.

stages.title: Subject
stages.intent: Who or what occupies the frame.

stages.title: Lighting
stages.intent: Motivated light intent, not a render call.

stages.title: Duration Intent
stages.intent: Relative length, not an encoded video.
